# Module C3 (`TauVanishing/PIT/Tauberian.lean`, `TauVanishing/PIT/Tauberian/**`)

No third-party code was ported. The proof was written from scratch on top of Mathlib only:

- `mellinInv_mellin_eq` (Mellin inversion), `hasMellin`-style computations via `integral_cpow`;
- `Complex.integral_boundary_rect_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn` (rectangle Cauchy–Goursat);
- `integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm`, `integral_integral_swap` (Fubini);
- `integral_Ioi_cpow_of_lt`, `integrable_one_add_norm`.

PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (`PerronFormula`) was only skimmed for its lemma list, and AINTLIB was not
used. Nothing was copied, so no attribution header is required.
